basis: hyperref package (\href{URL}{text}): only the first {URL} argument is scanned verbatim (allowing '%7E', balanced '{id}', and trailing '%' without starting a comment), while the second {text} argument is normal LaTeX prose where '\cite{k2}' and '\label{sec:in_href_text}' take effect alongside trailing '\cite{k1}' and '\label{sec:after_href}'.
